senses.gloss: f.(b. h., אשש)anything made compact and substantial by pressing, whence

units: Pes. 36ᵇ excluding from ‘bread of misery’, חלוט וא׳ pudding and pan-cake. [Talmudic etymology, ibid., ‘one sixth of an epha of flour made into a cake’.] Y. ib. II, 29ᵇ bot.—Bab. ib. l. c. Samuel says א׳ גרבא וכ׳ ăshishah (II Sam. VI, 19) means a jug of wine (v. preced.).—Pl. אֲשִׁישׁוֹת (b. h.).

<cite ref="Chullin 124b:17">Ḥull. 124ᵇ</cite> <he>אני היום סמכוני בא׳</he> to me to-day the Bibl. words apply, ‘Support me with cakes’ (<cite ref="Song of Songs 2:5">Cant. II, 5</cite>); <cite ref="Beitzah 21a:3">Bets. 21ᵃ</cite>
